thread:
Avery (Marketing): Draft ready for final QA — product launch post for 'Redwood Optimize: Inference Cost Optimizer'. Asking for quick checks: benchmark blurb, legal claim review, CTA mapping to webinar + HubSpot routing. Pinged everyone who touched the draft. :party_parrot:

Kai (Growth): nice! can you attach the small benchmark table (2 bullets) and a link to the raw CSV? need the top-line numbers for the hero and the long-form appendix. also want 2 headline variants for an A/B test.

Avery (Marketing): Attached raw CSV in the thread (see drive link). Hero numbers I have: "~3x cost reduction on long-tail requests with caching" and "latency < 90ms p95 on bursty workloads" — will tighten wording if legal flags. Headline options: 1) 'Cut inference costs with smarter serving' 2) 'Reduce token spend by up to 3x without losing latency'

Maya (Legal): quick pass on both hero claims is possible but need sources inline. Please add a parenthetical to the hero pointing to the appendix table and the benchmark methodology note. Also avoid 'guarantee' language — use 'observed' or 'in our tests'.

Jordan (Product): For the benchmark methodology note: add the config block we used for Dedicated (A100x4, seq=1024, mixed quant). I'll paste it here so marketing can copy into the appendix.

Jordan (Product): ```
Benchmark config: Dedicated A100x4, batch target=64, seq_len=1024, model=rw-opt-13b-quant, KV cache warmup=10K tokens
Method: 1M tokens of mixed prompt lengths (50/200/800 distribution), 3 runs, median reported
```

Priya (PM): On webinar gating: we want a two-step flow — capture email on post CTA -> send to registration page with hidden utm params -> HubSpot form maps to 'Launch:Optimize' lifecycle stage. Also recommend sending high-intent signups to SDR queue tag 'Optimize-Launch-AE' for next-day follow up.

Avery (Marketing): OK I'm adding CTA mapping. HubSpot field mapping snippet below: 
```
utm_source=blog
utm_campaign=optimize-launch
hs_form=optimize_launch_reg
owner_assignment_rule=Optimize-Launch-AE
```

Kai (Growth): For UTM and Social: can we standardize the utm_campaign to 'optimize_launch_q2' and add an experiment param 'headline_ab=1|2' so Analytics can surface headline performance?

Avery (Marketing): yes changing campaign to that. will add experiment param.

Maya (Legal): send me the final hero and the 1-paragraph claim justification in this thread before EOD. I can do a final sign-off tomorrow morning.

Priya (PM): note on inbound routing: can we set a HubSpot workflow to tag leads with 'source:blog' + 'interest:cost-optimizer' and push to SFDC queue 'AE_Launch_Optimize'? Jordan / EngOps if that's doable from your end?

Jordan (Product): EngOps: yes we can push to the SFDC queue. need the exact property names HubSpot will use — Avery, please confirm the property keys you plan to emit.

Avery (Marketing): property keys: 'utm_campaign', 'experiment_headline', 'lead_score_initial', 'interest_topic' (value=cost-optimizer). I'll post the final JSON mapping in the morning.

LaunchBot: Friendly reminder — Automatically scheduling: if all approvals (legal + product + marketing) are present by Wed 18:00 PT, publish window is Thu 09:00 PT. Otherwise will hold.

Kai (Growth): ETA for final hero w/ method link + HubSpot mapping?

Avery (Marketing): I'll push updates in an hour, Maya take a look after that. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:

Maya (Legal): on it.

Jordan (Product): thumbs up from product for methodology and routing.

Priya (PM): queueing SDR kickoff doc once mappings live.

Avery (Marketing): perfect — final checklist: 1) legal blurb in thread 2) appendix csv link included 3) HubSpot mapping JSON posted 4) headline A/B saved in CMS. Will update here when done.
